item.name: Retrieve geolocation and threat intelligence data for multiple IP addresses in a single request

request.name: Retrieve geolocation and threat intelligence data for multiple IP addresses in a single request

description.content: Get detailed IP geolocation data for multiple IP addresses including country, city, timezone, currency, and optional threat intelligence information. Supports up to 50,000 IP addresses per request.

query.description: Response language for location fields. Default: en.
Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. For example, `location` includes all location fields, `location.city` is a specific field.
Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from response.

Comma-separated list of additional data modules to include. Possible values: security (threat intelligence), hostname (IP-Hostname lookup), liveHostname (live hostname lookup), user_agent (parse User-Agent header), abuse (abuse contact info), * (all modules).

response.name: Successful geolocation response. Each item corresponds to one requested IP, in the same order; an IP that fails validation (invalid, bogon, reserved, or not found) yields an error item instead of a location result.

request.name: Retrieve real-time and accurate IP geolocation and threat intelligence information for an IPv4 or IPv6 address

description.content: Get detailed IP geolocation data for an IP address including country, city, timezone, currency, and optional threat intelligence and user-agent information.

query.description: IPv4, IPv6, or hostname for geolocation lookup.
Response language for location fields. Default: en.
Comma-separated list of fields to include in response. For example, `location` includes all location fields, `location.city` is a specific field.
Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from response.

Comma-separated list of additional data modules to include. Possible values: security (threat intelligence), hostname (IP-Hostname lookup), liveHostname (live hostname lookup), hostnameFallbackLive (hostname with live fallback), user_agent (parse User-Agent header), abuse (abuse contact info), dma_code (DMA code), geo_accuracy (accuracy_radius, confidence, locality), * (all modules).

query.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return. Supports dot notation (e.g. security.threat_score).

response.name: Successful threat intelligence response. The response array always contains one item for each input IP, preserving order; an IP that fails validation (invalid, bogon, reserved, or not found) yields an error item instead of a security result.

item.name: Retrieve real-time threat intelligence and security signals for an IPv4 or IPv6 address

request.name: Retrieve real-time threat intelligence and security signals for an IPv4 or IPv6 address

description.content: Get a threat score along with VPN, proxy, Tor, relay, bot, spam, known-attacker, and cloud-provider detection flags for an IP address.

query.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to check for threat intelligence and security signals. If omitted, the public IP of the requesting client is used.
Comma-separated list of fields to return. Supports dot notation (e.g. `security.threat_score`).
Comma-separated list of fields to remove from the response. Supports dot notation (e.g. `security.is_tor`). The `ip` field is always included and cannot be excluded.
